limits: Exact native skullA / ChaosSkullTop / renderer 121577 source assignment only; ChaosSkullBottom is a separate topology route and is not credited by this record.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced health from 69 to 61; death used the explicit KillSingle fixture and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Thirty selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining captured frames and generated videos are retained evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The native Death effect deactivated the skull renderer between selected frames 24 and 26 and replaced it with a particle burst, so this archive accepts a clean destruction handoff without claiming a visible articulated corpse pose.
Portrait, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime, other native ability variants, and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
